match.brief.title: Matchday briefing
match.firstDay.title: Day one as {team} manager
match.firstDay.step1Text: Check any items marked 'To do' in the checklist below. Tap one to jump straight to that screen.
match.firstDay.step2Text: Read the coach's notes in the opposition report and pick your tactics. There's no right answer like a win probability — it's your call.
match.firstDay.step3Text: During the match, use 'Touchline' to make subs and change tactics. At half-time, give your team talk in the dressing room.
match.firstDay.foot: Tap a player in the squad to see roles and swaps, and check your inbox for board and player news.

match.cmd.tacticsNote: Your instructions reach the players as soon as you choose.
match.pi.note: Tap a player to change his role and instructions; changes apply immediately. Roles stay with the position (a substitute takes them over), while individual instructions apply only to that player for this match. Man-marking can shut down a key opponent, but means more cards and more fatigue.

match.after.verdict.win.fav: We did the job. Good sides don't let games like this slip.
As expected, but it wasn't easy. The lads held their nerve.
Three points, nice and clean. Same focus next week and we'll be fine.
match.after.verdict.win.even: We edged a tight one. Today the small margins went our way.
A coin-toss game and we won it. The dressing room is buzzing.
We got past an evenly matched side. Wins like this change a season.
match.after.verdict.win.dog: Nobody gave us a chance. The players believed in you, boss.
That's an upset. People will be talking about this one tonight.
They had the better squad and we still won. This is why we do it.
match.after.verdict.draw.fav: We should have won that. Two points dropped.
A frustrating afternoon. The finishing let us down.
We didn't lose, but that's not good enough. We need to open them up next time.
match.after.verdict.draw.even: Neither side had the killer touch. A point isn't bad.
Only a draw, but there's plenty to take from the performance.
match.after.verdict.draw.dog: A hard-earned point. That one's worth having.
We stood up well against a strong side. Proud of the lads.
Most expected us to lose, and we came away with a point.
match.after.verdict.loss.fav: No excuses for that one. The players know it.
We let a winnable game slip. It's quiet in the dressing room.
We weren't ourselves today. We need to shake it off quickly.
match.after.verdict.loss.even: Beaten by small margins. One or two moments decided it.
It was tight until we cracked late on. We'll regroup.
Disappointing result, but the performance wasn't all bad.
match.after.verdict.loss.dog: The result we feared, but we didn't fold.
We couldn't bridge the gap. Still, there are lessons in that.
They played like a top side. It shows us where we need to get to.
